name: Monthly Group Report - Insurance
report_script:
columns = [
	{"label": "Claim ID / Employee / Bill", "fieldname": "name",             "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 200},
	{"label": "Group No.",                  "fieldname": "group_no",         "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 110},
	{"label": "Group Month",                "fieldname": "group_month",      "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 110},
	{"label": "Employee Name / Patient",    "fieldname": "employee_name",    "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 160},
	{"label": "Membership No.",             "fieldname": "employee",         "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 140},
	{"label": "Insurance Period",           "fieldname": "insurance_period", "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 130},
	{"label": "Form Type / Purpose",        "fieldname": "claim_type",       "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 140},
	{"label": "Claim Status / Assessment",  "fieldname": "claim_status",     "fieldtype": "data1",     "width": 160},
	{"label": "Officer Decision",           "fieldname": "checked_by_officer","fieldtype": "data1",    "width": 120},
	{"label": "Manager Decision / Remark",  "fieldname": "checked_by_manager","fieldtype": "data1",   "width": 140},
	{"label": "Bill Date",                  "fieldname": "issue_date",      "fieldtype": "Date",     "width": 100},
	{"label": "OPD Amt / Bill Amt",         "fieldname": "amount_m",         "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
	{"label": "IPD Amount",                 "fieldname": "amount",           "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
	{"label": "Agrahara Settled",           "fieldname": "agrahara_settled_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140},
	{"label": "Final Amount",               "fieldname": "amount_s",         "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
	{"label": "Total Claims",               "fieldname": "total_claims",     "fieldtype": "Int",      "width": 100},
	{"label": "Approved",                   "fieldname": "approved_count",   "fieldtype": "Int",      "width": 90},
	{"label": "Rejected",                   "fieldname": "rejected_count",   "fieldtype": "Int",      "width": 90},
	{"label": "Pending",                    "fieldname": "pending_count",    "fieldtype": "Int",      "width": 90}
]

db_filters = [["docstatus", "<", 2]]

if filters.get("employee"):
	db_filters.append(["empins", "=", filters["employee"]])
if filters.get("group_month"):
	db_filters.append(["group_month", "=", filters["group_month"]])
if filters.get("membership_no"):
	db_filters.append(["employee", "=", filters["membership_no"]])
if filters.get("insurance_period"):
	db_filters.append(["insurance_period", "=", filters["insurance_period"]])
if filters.get("claim_type"):
	db_filters.append(["claim_type", "=", filters["claim_type"]])
if filters.get("claim_status"):
	db_filters.append(["claim_status", "=", filters["claim_status"]])
if filters.get("category"):
	db_filters.append(["category", "=", filters["category"]])
if filters.get("checked_by_officer"):
	db_filters.append(["checked_by_officer", "=", filters["checked_by_officer"]])
if filters.get("checked_by_manager"):
	db_filters.append(["checked_by_manager", "=", filters["checked_by_manager"]])

results = frappe.db.get_list(
	"Insurance Claim",
	filters=db_filters,
	fields=["name","employee","empins","insurance_period","claim_type","claim_status",
		"checked_by_officer","checked_by_manager","amount_m","amount",
		"agrahara_settled_amount","amount_s","group_no", "group_month"],
	order_by="empins asc, creation asc",
	ignore_permissions=False
)

filtered_results = []

for r in results:
	claim_no = 0
	name = r.get("name") or ""

	parts = name.split("-")

	try:
		# HR-CLM-2026-00124
		if len(parts) == 4:
			claim_no = int(parts[3])

		# HR-CLM-2026-00124-1
		elif len(parts) >= 5:
			claim_no = int(parts[3])

	except ValueError:
		claim_no = 0

	if claim_no >= 100:
		filtered_results.append(r)

results = filtered_results

approved_statuses = ["Approved"]
rejected_statuses = ["Rejected","Declined by Officer","Declined by Manager",
	"Cancelled by Manager","Cancelled by Officer"]

grouped = {}
grouped_order = []

for row in results:
	empins_val = row.get("empins") or ""
	group_no_val = row.get("group_no") or ""
	claim_type_val = row.get("claim_type") or ""

	# Group by employee + form type (claim_type) - not by group_no. One
	# employee can have separate claim groups for different form types in
	# the same period (e.g. an OPD group and a Surgical group), and each
	# of those form types must collapse into exactly ONE row showing ONE
	# group_no - never split into multiple rows, and never mixing several
	# group_no values together under the same form type. Grouping by
	# group_no itself (or group_no+claim_type) was wrong: it fragmented a
	# single employee/form-type block into extra rows whenever more than
	# one group_no happened to show up for that type. group_no on the row
	# itself is simply taken from whichever claim is encountered first for
	# that employee/type (see below) - it should already be the single
	# correct value for an active group.
	key = (empins_val, claim_type_val)

	if key not in grouped:
		grouped_order.append(key)
		emp_name = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", empins_val, "employee_name") or "" if empins_val else ""
		grouped[key] = {
			"empins":        empins_val,
			"emp_name":      emp_name,
			"membership_no": row.get("employee") or "",
			"group_no":      group_no_val,
			"group_month":      row.get("group_month") or "",
			"claim_type":  row.get("claim_type") or "",
			"total_claims":  0,
			"approved_count": 0,
			"rejected_count": 0,
			"pending_count":  0,
			"total_amount_m": 0.0,
			"total_amount":   0.0,
			"total_agrahara": 0.0,
			"total_amount_s": 0.0,
			"claims": []
		}

	g = grouped[key]
	g["total_claims"] = g["total_claims"] + 1

	status = row.get("claim_status") or ""
	if status in approved_statuses:
		g["approved_count"] = g["approved_count"] + 1
	elif status in rejected_statuses:
		g["rejected_count"] = g["rejected_count"] + 1
	else:
		g["pending_count"] = g["pending_count"] + 1

	g["total_amount_m"] = g["total_amount_m"] + (row.get("amount_m") or 0)
	g["total_amount"]   = g["total_amount"]   + (row.get("amount") or 0)
	g["total_agrahara"] = g["total_agrahara"] + (row.get("agrahara_settled_amount") or 0)
	g["total_amount_s"] = g["total_amount_s"] + (row.get("amount_s") or 0)

	claim_doc = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Claim", row.get("name"))
	bill_rows = []
	for b in (claim_doc.details_regarding_bills or []):
		bill_rows.append({
			"bill_no":       b.bill_no or "",
			"issue_date":   b.issue_date,
			"purpose":       b.purpose or "",
			"doctors_name":  b.doctors_name or "",
			"patiants_name": b.patiants_name or "",
			"amount":        b.amount or 0,
			"assessment":    b.assessment or "",
			"remark":        b.remark or "",
			"category":      b.category or ""
		})

	g["claims"].append({
		"name":                    row.get("name") or "",
		"employee":                row.get("employee") or "",
		"group_no":                row.get("group_no") or "",
		"group_month":             row.get("group_month") or "",
		"insurance_period":        row.get("insurance_period") or "",
		"claim_type":              row.get("claim_type") or "",
		"claim_status":            row.get("claim_status") or "",
		"checked_by_officer":      row.get("checked_by_officer") or "",
		"checked_by_manager":      row.get("checked_by_manager") or "",
		"amount_m":                row.get("amount_m") or 0,
		"amount":                  row.get("amount") or 0,
		"agrahara_settled_amount": row.get("agrahara_settled_amount") or 0,
		"amount_s":                row.get("amount_s") or 0,
		"bills":                   bill_rows
	})

data1 = []
for key in grouped_order:
	g = grouped[key]

	# indent 0 — Employee summary row
	data1.append({
		"name":                    g["empins"],
		"group_no":                g["group_no"],
		"group_month":             g["group_month"],
		"employee_name":           g["emp_name"],
		"employee":                g["membership_no"],
		"insurance_period":        "",
		"claim_type":              g["claim_type"],
		"claim_status":            "",
		"checked_by_officer":      "",
		"checked_by_manager":      "",
		"issue_date":             None,
		"purpose":                None,
		"amount_m":                g["total_amount_m"],
		"amount":                  g["total_amount"],
		"agrahara_settled_amount": g["total_agrahara"],
		"amount_s":                g["total_amount_s"],
		"total_claims":            g["total_claims"],
		"approved_count":          g["approved_count"],
		"rejected_count":          g["rejected_count"],
		"pending_count":           g["pending_count"],
		"indent":                  0
	})

	for claim in g["claims"]:
		# indent 1 — Claim row
		data1.append({
			"name":                    claim["name"],
			"group_no":                claim["group_no"],
			"group_month":                claim["group_month"],
			"employee_name":           "",
			"employee":                claim["employee"],
			"insurance_period":        claim["insurance_period"],
			"claim_type":              claim["claim_type"],
			"claim_status":            claim["claim_status"],
			"checked_by_officer":      claim["checked_by_officer"],
			"checked_by_manager":      claim["checked_by_manager"],
			"issue_date":             None,
			"purpose":             None,
			"amount_m":                claim["amount_m"],
			"amount":                  claim["amount"],
			"agrahara_settled_amount": claim["agrahara_settled_amount"],
			"amount_s":                claim["amount_s"],
			"total_claims":            "",
			"approved_count":          "",
			"rejected_count":          "",
			"pending_count":           "",
			"indent":                  1
		})

		for bill in claim["bills"]:
			# indent 2 — Bill row
			data1.append({
				"name":                    bill.get("bill_no") or "",
				"group_no":                "",
				"group_month":             "",
				"employee_name":           bill.get("patiants_name") or "",
				"employee":                "",
				"insurance_period":        bill.get("category") or "",
				"claim_type":              bill.get("claim_type") or "",
				"claim_status":            bill.get("assessment") or "",
				"checked_by_officer":      bill.get("doctors_name") or "",
				"checked_by_manager":      bill.get("remark") or "",
				"issue_date":             bill.get("issue_date"),
				"purpose":             bill.get("purpose"),
				"amount_m":                bill.get("amount") or 0,
				"amount":                  0,
				"agrahara_settled_amount": 0,
				"amount_s":                0,
				"total_claims":            "",
				"approved_count":          "",
				"rejected_count":          "",
				"pending_count":           "",
				"indent":                  2
			})

data = columns, data1

report_script: CLAIM_TYPE_SURGICAL = "Surgical and hospital expenses claim" columns = [ {"label": "Claim Type Group", "fieldname": "claim_type_group", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, # {"label": "Employee No.", "fieldname": "employee_no", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Employee", "width": 160}, {"label": "Employee Name", "fieldname": "employee_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180}, {"label": "Claim Group No.", "fieldname": "group_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, {"label": "Grand Total", "fieldname": "grand_total", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140} ] db_filters = [["docstatus", "<", 2]] #db_filters.append(["claim_status", "=", "Accepted by Manager"]) if filters.get("employee"): db_filters.append(["empins", "=", filters["employee"]]) if filters.get("group_month"): db_filters.append(["group_month", "=", filters["group_month"]]) if filters.get("membership_no"): db_filters.append(["employee", "=", filters["membership_no"]]) if filters.get("insurance_period"): db_filters.append(["insurance_period", "=", filters["insurance_period"]]) if filters.get("claim_type"): db_filters.append(["claim_type", "=", filters["claim_type"]]) if filters.get("claim_status"): db_filters.append(["claim_status", "=", filters["claim_status"]]) if filters.get("category"): db_filters.append(["category", "=", filters["category"]]) if filters.get("checked_by_officer"): db_filters.append(["checked_by_officer", "=", filters["checked_by_officer"]]) if filters.get("checked_by_manager"): db_filters.append(["checked_by_manager", "=", filters["checked_by_manager"]]) if filters.get("group_no"): db_filters.append(["group_no", "=", filters["group_no"]]) results = frappe.db.get_list( "Insurance Claim", filters=db_filters, fields=["name", "employee", "empins", "group_no", "claim_type", "amount_m", "amount", "agrahara_settled_amount", "amount_s", "group_month"], order_by="empins asc, creation asc", ignore_permissions=False ) # Same "real claim" filter used elsewhere: drop claims whose numeric suffix # in the name (HR-CLM-2026-00124[-N]) is below 100 — these are test/draft # style records that shouldn't be counted in totals. filtered_results = [] for r in results: claim_no = 0 name = r.get("name") or "" parts = name.split("-") try: if len(parts) == 4: claim_no = int(parts[3]) elif len(parts) >= 5: claim_no = int(parts[3]) except ValueError: claim_no = 0 if claim_no >= 100: filtered_results.append(r) results = filtered_results # Group by (employee, bucket) where bucket is "Surgical" or "Other". # An employee with both kinds of claims gets one row in each bucket, so # their Surgical total and non-Surgical total stay separate rather than # being blended into a single figure. groups = {} group_order = [] for row in results: emp_key = row.get("empins") or "" claim_type = row.get("claim_type") or "" bucket = "Surgical" if claim_type == CLAIM_TYPE_SURGICAL else "Other" key = (emp_key, bucket) if key not in groups: group_order.append(key) emp_name = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", emp_key, "employee_name") or "" if emp_key else "" groups[key] = { "employee_name": emp_name, "group_no": row.get("group_no") or "", "grand_total": 0.0 } g = groups[key] # "Grand Total" = every amount field on the claim, summed together. g["grand_total"] = ( g["grand_total"] + (row.get("amount_m") or 0) #+ (row.get("amount") or 0) #+ (row.get("agrahara_settled_amount") or 0) + (row.get("amount_s") or 0) ) if row.get("group_no"): g["group_no"] = row.get("group_no") # Split the keys we saw (in first-seen order) into the two buckets, then # put every Surgical row ahead of every Other row. surgical_keys = [k for k in group_order if k[1] == "Surgical"] other_keys = [k for k in group_order if k[1] == "Other"] data1 = [] surgical_total = 0.0 other_total = 0.0 for key in surgical_keys: g = groups[key] surgical_total = surgical_total + g["grand_total"] data1.append({ "claim_type_group": "Surgical", "employee_no": key[0], "employee_name": g["employee_name"], "group_no": g["group_no"], "grand_total": g["grand_total"] }) if surgical_keys: data1.append({ "claim_type_group": "", "employee_no": "", "employee_name": "Surgical Sub-Total", "group_no": "", "grand_total": surgical_total }) for key in other_keys: g = groups[key] other_total = other_total + g["grand_total"] data1.append({ "claim_type_group": "Other", "employee_no": key[0], "employee_name": g["employee_name"], "group_no": g["group_no"], "grand_total": g["grand_total"] }) if other_keys: data1.append({ "claim_type_group": "", "employee_no": "", "employee_name": "Other Sub-Total", "group_no": "", "grand_total": other_total }) # Trailing overall totals row data1.append({ "claim_type_group": "", "employee_no": "", "employee_name": "Overall Total", "group_no": "", "grand_total": surgical_total + other_total }) data = columns, data1

report_script: CLAIM_TYPE_SURGICAL = "Surgical and hospital expenses claim" columns = [ # {"label": "Claim Type Group", "fieldname": "claim_type_group", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, {"label": "Employee No.", "fieldname": "employee_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160}, {"label": "Employee Name", "fieldname": "employee_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180}, {"label": "Claim Group No.", "fieldname": "group_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, {"label": "Purchase Order No.", "fieldname": "purchase_order", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, {"label": "Approved Amount", "fieldname": "grand_total", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140} ] db_filters = [["docstatus", "<", 2]] # Restrict to Approved claims by default - this was previously commented out, # and the report instead relied on a numeric-suffix cutoff (see removed # `claim_no >= 100` filter further down) that assumed IDs like # HR-CLM-2026-00124. Real Claim Approval records are named # HR-CLA-2026-000NN and only go up to ~00043 so far, so that cutoff # silently discarded every single record, Approved or not. # Filtering on claim_status directly is the correct way to get "all data # of Approved" - defaults to "Approved" but still respects an explicit # claim_status filter from the report's filter panel if one is passed in. db_filters.append(["claim_status", "=", filters.get("claim_status") or "Approved"]) if not filters.get("group_month"): frappe.throw("Please select a Group Month to run this report.") db_filters.append(["summary", "=", filters["group_month"]]) #if filters.get("empins"): # db_filters.append(["empins", "=", filters["empins"]]) if filters.get("claim_group"): db_filters.append(["claim_group", "=", filters["claim_group"]]) # NOTE: "claim_type" and "group_no" are NOT fields on the Claim Approval # doctype - fetching them was always a no-op, so every row silently # bucketed as "Other" and group_no was always blank. The doctype's actual # fields are "claim_group" (Link -> Employee Claim Group) and "claim_no" # (Link -> Insurance Claim, only set for single/surgical claims - see the # form script's `if (frm.doc.claim_no) { ...surgical... } else { ...opd... }` # convention). "purchase_order" is also pulled in now since it's listed as # a report column but was never fetched. results = frappe.db.get_list( "Claim Approval", filters=db_filters, fields=["name", "summary", "employee", "claim_group", "claim_no", "purchase_order", "approved_amount"], order_by="employee asc, creation asc", ignore_permissions=False ) # Group by (employee, bucket) where bucket is "Surgical" or "Other". # An employee with both kinds of claims gets one row in each bucket, so # their Surgical total and non-Surgical total stay separate rather than # being blended into a single figure. # # Bucket is now derived from claim_no (set only for single/surgical claims), # matching the convention already used in the Claim Approval form script, # rather than the previous nonexistent "claim_type" field. groups = {} group_order = [] for row in results: #emp_key = row.get("empins") or "" emp_key = frappe.db.get_value("Insurance Member", row.get("employee"), "employee") or "" bucket = "Surgical" if row.get("claim_no") else "Other" key = (emp_key, bucket) if key not in groups: group_order.append(key) emp_name = frappe.db.get_value("Insurance Member", row.get("employee"), "employee_name") or "" groups[key] = { "employee_name": emp_name, "group_no": row.get("claim_group") or "", "purchase_order": row.get("purchase_order") or "", "grand_total": 0.0 } g = groups[key] # "Grand Total" = every amount field on the claim, summed together. g["grand_total"] = ( g["grand_total"] + (row.get("approved_amount") or 0) #+ (row.get("amount") or 0) #+ (row.get("agrahara_settled_amount") or 0) #+ (row.get("amount_s") or 0) ) if row.get("claim_group"): g["group_no"] = row.get("claim_group") if row.get("purchase_order"): g["purchase_order"] = row.get("purchase_order") # Sort all groups together by purchase_order, instead of sorting within # the Surgical and Other buckets separately - rows from both buckets are # interleaved in a single purchase_order-ordered list. Rows with no # purchase_order (empty string) sort ahead of any real PO value. # # NOTE: query report scripts run via exec() with separate globals/locals # dicts, so a lambda referencing a script-level name (e.g. `groups`) # raises NameError - the lambda's free-variable lookup goes through # globals, not the locals dict these top-level assignments land in. # Building the (sort_key, key) pairs with a plain for-loop first avoids # that, since the loop body runs in the same top-level scope. sortable = [] for key in group_order: sortable.append((groups[key]["purchase_order"], key)) sortable.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0]) sorted_keys = [key for _, key in sortable] data1 = [] surgical_total = 0.0 other_total = 0.0 for key in sorted_keys: g = groups[key] bucket = key[1] if bucket == "Surgical": surgical_total = surgical_total + g["grand_total"] else: other_total = other_total + g["grand_total"] data1.append({ "claim_type_group": bucket, "employee_no": key[0], "employee_name": g["employee_name"], "group_no": g["group_no"], "purchase_order": g["purchase_order"], "grand_total": g["grand_total"] }) # Trailing overall totals row #data1.append({ # "claim_type_group": "", # "employee_no": "", # "employee_name": "Overall Total", # "group_no": "", # "purchase_order": "", # "grand_total": surgical_total + other_total #}) data = columns, data1

report_script:
CLAIM_TYPE_SURGICAL = "Surgical and hospital expenses claim"

columns = [
	{"label": "Employee No.",   "fieldname": "employee_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160},
	{"label": "Employee Name",  "fieldname": "employee_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
	{"label": "Claim Group No.", "fieldname": "group_no",    "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
	{"label": "Purchase Order No.", "fieldname": "purchase_order",    "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
	{"label": "Approved Amount",    "fieldname": "grand_total",  "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140}
]

db_filters = [["docstatus", "<", 2]]

db_filters.append(["claim_status", "=", filters.get("claim_status") or "Approved"])

if not filters.get("group_month"):
    frappe.throw("Please select a Group Month to run this report.")
    
db_filters.append(["summary", "=", filters["group_month"]])

if filters.get("claim_group"):
	db_filters.append(["claim_group", "=", filters["claim_group"]])

results = frappe.db.get_list(
	"Claim Approval",
	filters=db_filters,
	fields=["name", "summary", "employee", "claim_group", "claim_no", "purchase_order", "approved_amount"],
	order_by="employee asc, creation asc",
	ignore_permissions=False
)

groups = {}
group_order = []

for row in results:
	#emp_key = row.get("empins") or ""
	emp_key = frappe.db.get_value("Insurance Member", row.get("employee"), "employee") or ""
	bucket = "Surgical" if row.get("claim_no") else "Other"
	key = (emp_key, bucket)

	if key not in groups:
		group_order.append(key)
		emp_name = frappe.db.get_value("Insurance Member", row.get("employee"), "employee_name") or ""
		groups[key] = {
			"employee_name": emp_name,
			"group_no": row.get("claim_group") or "",
			"purchase_order": row.get("purchase_order") or "",
			"grand_total": 0.0
		}

	g = groups[key]

	# "Grand Total" = every amount field on the claim, summed together.
	g["grand_total"] = (
		g["grand_total"]
		+ (row.get("approved_amount") or 0)
	)

	if row.get("claim_group"):
		g["group_no"] = row.get("claim_group")
	if row.get("purchase_order"):
		g["purchase_order"] = row.get("purchase_order")

sortable = []
for key in group_order:
	sortable.append((groups[key]["purchase_order"], key))

sortable.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])
sorted_keys = [key for _, key in sortable]

data1 = []
surgical_total = 0.0
other_total = 0.0

for key in sorted_keys:
	g = groups[key]
	bucket = key[1]
	if bucket == "Surgical":
		surgical_total = surgical_total + g["grand_total"]
	else:
		other_total = other_total + g["grand_total"]

	data1.append({
		"claim_type_group": bucket,
		"employee_no": key[0],
		"employee_name": g["employee_name"],
		"group_no": g["group_no"],
		"purchase_order": g["purchase_order"],
		"grand_total": g["grand_total"]
	})

data = columns, data1

report_script:
db_filters = [["docstatus", "<", 2]]

if filters.get("docstatus") not in (None, ""):
	db_filters = [["docstatus", "=", int(filters["docstatus"])]]

if filters.get("insurance_scheme"):
	db_filters.append(["insurance_scheme", "=", filters["insurance_scheme"]])

if filters.get("scheme"):
	support_names = frappe.db.get_all("Support Scheme", filters={"scheme": filters["scheme"]}, pluck="name")
	db_filters.append(["insurance_scheme", "in", support_names or ["__none__"]])

if filters.get("fiscal_year"):
	db_filters.append(["fiscal_year", "=", filters["fiscal_year"]])

if filters.get("member_status"):
	db_filters.append(["member_status", "=", filters["member_status"]])

if filters.get("employee"):
	db_filters.append(["employee", "=", filters["employee"]])

if filters.get("department"):
	db_filters.append(["department", "=", filters["department"]])
	
db_filters.append(["member_status", "=", "Active"])	

members = frappe.db.get_list(
	"Insurance Member",
	filters=db_filters,
	fields=["name", "employee", "employee_name", "department", "division", "insurance_scheme",
		"monthly_deduction", "enrollment_date", "fiscal_year", "member_status", "agrahara_member"],
	order_by="insurance_scheme asc, employee_name asc",
	ignore_permissions=False
)

# Support Scheme.name = Insurance Member.insurance_scheme ; "Scheme" comes from Support Scheme.scheme
scheme_by_support = {}
for ss in frappe.db.get_all("Support Scheme", fields=["name", "scheme"]):
	scheme_by_support[ss.get("name")] = ss.get("scheme")

member_names = []
for m in members:
	member_names.append(m.get("name"))

dependent_rows = []
if member_names:
	dependent_rows = frappe.db.get_all(
		"Insurance Dependent",
		filters={"parent": ["in", member_names], "parenttype": "Insurance Member"},
		fields=["parent", "name_with_initials", "age", "relationship", "cert", "idx"],
		order_by="parent asc, idx asc"
	)

dependents_by_member = {}
for d in dependent_rows:
	dependents_by_member.setdefault(d.get("parent"), []).append(d)

columns = [
	{"label": "Scheme", "fieldname": "insurance_scheme", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Insurance Scheme", "width": 200},
	{"label": "Insurance Member", "fieldname": "member", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Insurance Member", "width": 150},
	{"label": "Employee", "fieldname": "employee", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Employee", "width": 110},
	{"label": "Type", "fieldname": "row_type", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 90},
	{"label": "Name", "fieldname": "person_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200},
	{"label": "Relationship", "fieldname": "relationship", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
	{"label": "Age", "fieldname": "age", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 60},
	{"label": "Marriage/Birth Cert.", "fieldname": "cert", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
	{"label": "Department", "fieldname": "department", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Department", "width": 140},
	{"label": "Division", "fieldname": "division", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Branch", "width": 120},
	{"label": "Enrollment Date", "fieldname": "enrollment_date", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
	{"label": "Fiscal Year", "fieldname": "fiscal_year", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 90},
	{"label": "Status", "fieldname": "member_status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
	{"label": "Monthly Deduction", "fieldname": "monthly_deduction", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
]

data1 = []
scheme_member_count = {}
scheme_dependent_count = {}
scheme_deduction = {}
scheme_order = []

for m in members:
	scheme = scheme_by_support.get(m.get("insurance_scheme")) or m.get("insurance_scheme") or "No Scheme"
	if scheme not in scheme_member_count:
		scheme_order.append(scheme)
		scheme_member_count[scheme] = 0
		scheme_dependent_count[scheme] = 0
		scheme_deduction[scheme] = 0.0

	deps = dependents_by_member.get(m.get("name"), [])
	scheme_member_count[scheme] = scheme_member_count[scheme] + 1
	scheme_dependent_count[scheme] = scheme_dependent_count[scheme] + len(deps)
	scheme_deduction[scheme] = scheme_deduction[scheme] + (m.get("monthly_deduction") or 0)

	data1.append({
		"insurance_scheme": scheme,
		"member": m.get("name"),
		"employee": m.get("employee"),
		"row_type": "Member",
		"person_name": m.get("employee_name"),
		"department": m.get("department"),
		"division": m.get("division"),
		"enrollment_date": m.get("enrollment_date"),
		"fiscal_year": m.get("fiscal_year"),
		"member_status": m.get("member_status"),
		"monthly_deduction": m.get("monthly_deduction"),
		"indent": 0
	})

	for d in deps:
		# Scheme / Insurance Member / Employee are shown on the Member row only
		data1.append({
			"row_type": "Dependent",
			"person_name": d.get("name_with_initials"),
			"relationship": d.get("relationship"),
			"age": d.get("age"),
			"cert": d.get("cert"),
			"indent": 1
		})

# Scheme-wise summary rows at the bottom
data1.append({})
grand_members = 0
grand_dependents = 0
grand_deduction = 0.0

for scheme in scheme_order:
	data1.append({
		"insurance_scheme": scheme,
		"row_type": "Total",
		"person_name": "Members: %s | Dependents: %s" % (scheme_member_count[scheme], scheme_dependent_count[scheme]),
		"monthly_deduction": scheme_deduction[scheme]
	})
	grand_members = grand_members + scheme_member_count[scheme]
	grand_dependents = grand_dependents + scheme_dependent_count[scheme]
	grand_deduction = grand_deduction + scheme_deduction[scheme]

data1.append({
	"insurance_scheme": "Grand Total",
	"row_type": "Total",
	"person_name": "Members: %s | Dependents: %s" % (grand_members, grand_dependents),
	"monthly_deduction": grand_deduction
})

data = columns, data1

name: Insurance Summary Check
report_script:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Script Report: Insurance Summary Check
# One row per Insurance Member x Cover
# Includes Limit, Pending, Approved, Balance,
# and Balance Without Pending.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

filters = filters or {}

excluded = (
    "Approved",
    "Rejected",
    "Declined by Officer",
    "Declined by Manager",
    "Cancelled by Officer",
    "Cancelled by Manager",
)

columns = [
    {
        "label": "Member No.",
        "fieldname": "member",
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Insurance Member",
        "width": 130
    },
    {
        "label": "Member Name",
        "fieldname": "member_name",
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "width": 200
    },
    {
        "label": "Scheme",
        "fieldname": "scheme",
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Support Scheme",
        "width": 150
    },
    {
        "label": "Cover",
        "fieldname": "cover",
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "width": 170
    },
    {
        "label": "Limit",
        "fieldname": "limit_rs",
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 120
    },
    {
        "label": "Pending",
        "fieldname": "pending",
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 120
    },
    {
        "label": "Approved",
        "fieldname": "approved",
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 120
    },
    {
        "label": "Balance",
        "fieldname": "balance",
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 130
    },
    {
        "label": "Balance Without Pending",
        "fieldname": "balance_without_pending",
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 180
    },
        {
        "label": "Status",
        "fieldname": "status",
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "width": 170
    },
]

# 1. Fetch Insurance Members
member_filters = {}

if filters.get("member"):
    member_filters["name"] = filters.get("member")

if filters.get("member_status"):
    member_filters["member_status"] = filters.get("member_status")

if filters.get("insurance_scheme"):
    member_filters["insurance_scheme"] = filters.get("insurance_scheme")

members = frappe.db.get_list(
    "Insurance Member",
    filters=member_filters,
    fields=["name", "employee_name", "insurance_scheme"],
    order_by="name asc",
    limit_page_length=0,
)

# 2. Fetch Covers
categories = frappe.get_all(
    "Covers and Benefits",
    fields=["name", "c_name"],
    order_by="c_name asc",
    limit_page_length=0,
)

# 3. Fetch scheme limits
scheme_limits = {}

for m in members:
    if m.insurance_scheme and m.insurance_scheme not in scheme_limits:
        scheme_doc = frappe.get_doc(
            "Support Scheme",
            m.insurance_scheme
        )

        lim = {}

        for d in scheme_doc.limits_and_benefits:
            lim[d.short_name] = frappe.utils.flt(d.limit_rs)

        scheme_limits[m.insurance_scheme] = lim

# 4. Prepare claim query filters
values = {
    "excluded": excluded,
    "member_names": tuple([m.name for m in members]) or ("__none__",),
}

period_cond = " and c.employee in %(member_names)s "

if filters.get("insurance_period"):
    values["period"] = filters.get("insurance_period")
    period_cond = period_cond + " and c.insurance_period = %(period)s "

# 4a. OPD claims: amounts from Claim Bills child table
bill_rows = frappe.db.sql(
    """
    select
        c.employee as member,
        b.category as category,

        sum(
            case
                when ifnull(c.claim_status, '') = 'Approved'
                then ifnull(b.approved_amount, 0)
                else 0
            end
        ) as approved,

        sum(
            case
                when ifnull(c.claim_status, '') not in %(excluded)s
                then ifnull(b.amount, 0)
                else 0
            end
        ) as pending

    from `tabClaim Bills` b

    inner join `tabInsurance Claim` c
        on c.name = b.parent

    where
        b.parenttype = 'Insurance Claim'
        and c.docstatus < 2
    """
    + period_cond
    + """
    group by
        c.employee,
        b.category
    """,
    values,
    as_dict=True,
)

# 4b. Hospital claims: amounts from Insurance Claim
hosp_rows = frappe.db.sql(
    """
    select
        c.employee as member,
        cb.c_name as category,

        sum(
            case
                when ifnull(c.claim_status, '') = 'Approved'
                then ifnull(c.approved_amount_s, 0)
                else 0
            end
        ) as approved,

        sum(
            case
                when ifnull(c.claim_status, '') not in %(excluded)s
                then ifnull(c.amount_s, 0)
                else 0
            end
        ) as pending

    from `tabInsurance Claim` c

    inner join `tabCovers and Benefits` cb
        on cb.name = c.category

    where
        ifnull(c.category, '') != ''
        and cb.per_period = 1
        and c.docstatus < 2
    """
    + period_cond
    + """
    group by
        c.employee,
        cb.c_name
    """,
    values,
    as_dict=True,
)

# 5. Combine claim amounts by member and cover
used = {}

for r in bill_rows + hosp_rows:
    key = (r.member or "") + "||" + (r.category or "")

    if key not in used:
        used[key] = {
            "pending": 0,
            "approved": 0
        }

    used[key]["pending"] = (
        used[key]["pending"]
        + frappe.utils.flt(r.pending)
    )

    used[key]["approved"] = (
        used[key]["approved"]
        + frappe.utils.flt(r.approved)
    )

# 6. Build report rows
result = []

for m in members:
    lim = scheme_limits.get(m.insurance_scheme) or {}

    for cat in categories:

        # Cover filter
        if filters.get("category"):
            if (
                filters.get("category") != cat.name
                and filters.get("category") != cat.c_name
            ):
                continue

        limit_rs = frappe.utils.flt(lim.get(cat.c_name))

        key = (m.name or "") + "||" + (cat.c_name or "")

        u = used.get(key) or {}

        pending = frappe.utils.flt(u.get("pending"))
        approved = frappe.utils.flt(u.get("approved"))

                # Balance after pending and approved claims (rounded to 2 decimals
        # so equality checks are not broken by floating point errors)
        balance = frappe.utils.flt(limit_rs - pending - approved, 2)

        # Balance excluding pending claims
        balance_without_pending = frappe.utils.flt(limit_rs - approved, 2)

        # Approved more than the limit
        approved_over = frappe.utils.flt(approved - limit_rs, 2)

        # Status
        if approved_over > 0:
            status = "Fraud"
        elif approved == 0 and pending == 0:
            status = "Not used"
        elif balance < 0:
            status = "Over limit with pending"
        elif balance == 0:
            status = "Limit reached"
        else:
            status = "Within limit"

        # Filter: negative balance after pending claims
        if filters.get("only_negative") and balance >= 0:
            continue

        # Filter: negative balance excluding pending claims
        if filters.get("only_negative_act") and balance_without_pending >= 0:
            continue

        # Filter: approved more than the limit
        if filters.get("only_fraud") and approved_over <= 0:
            continue

        # Append row
        result.append({
            "member": m.name,
            "member_name": m.employee_name,
            "scheme": m.insurance_scheme,
            "cover": cat.c_name,
            "limit_rs": limit_rs,
            "pending": pending,
            "approved": approved,
            "balance": balance,
            "balance_without_pending": balance_without_pending,
            "status": status,
        })

# 7. Return report data
data = [columns, result]
